data.name: Ayiq
data.gender_notes: Ayiq is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who is strong, wise, and gives knowledge and guidance to others. The name Ayiq carries the meaning “Strong, wise one” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Ayiq usually hope their child will grow to embody strong, wise one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for those who seek knowledge and wisdom, and are a source of strength and guidance to others
data.etymology: Ayiq belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Strong, wise one.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ayiq total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: عايق
in_arabic.meaning: العايق: منبت القمل أو من يوقظ القمل من منامه
in_arabic.long_meaning: العايق في اللغة العربية هو الشخص الذي يوقظ القمل من منامه أو منبت القمل، وقد وردت هذه الكلمة في بعض المعاجم العربية القديمة، ومعناه الشخص الذي يثير أو يوقظ شيئًا ما كان هادئًا، وقد يرمز في بعض السياقات إلى الشخص الذي يبث روحًا جديدة في شيء ما كان راكدًا

in_urdu.name: عایق
in_urdu.meaning: عایق: قمل کا بستر یا قمل کو جگانے والا
in_urdu.long_meaning: عایق کا مطلب ہے وہ شخص جو قمل کو ان کی نیند سے جگاتا ہے یا قمل کا بستر ہے، یہ لفظ عربی جڑوں سے ماخوذ ہے اور بعض عربی لغات میں پाया جاتا ہے، جنوبی ایشیائی اسلامی ثقافت میں اس کا استعمال روحانی اور ثقافتی سیاق و سباق میں پایا جاتا ہے

in_hindi.name: आयिक
in_hindi.meaning: आयिक: जूँएँ को जगाने वाला या जूँएँ का घर
in_hindi.long_meaning: आयिक का अर्थ है वह व्यक्ति जो जूँएँ को उनकी नींद से जगाता है या जूँएँ का घर है, यह शब्द अरबी मूल से लिया गया है और कुछ अरबी शब्दकोशों में पाया जाता है, भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में इसका उपयोग पारंपरिक और आध्यात्मिक संदर्भों में किया जाता है

in_pashto.name: عايق
in_pashto.meaning: عايق: د کنه بستر یا د کنه ویښتی
in_pashto.long_meaning: عايق په پښتو کې هغه څوک دی چې کنه له خوبه راویښ کوي یا د کنه بستر دی، دا کلمه د عربي ريښو څخه اخیستل شوې ده او په ځینو عربي لغاتو کې موندل کیږي، د افغان او پښتني دودیزو او مذهبي سیاقونو کې کارول کیږي

in_english.name: Ayiq
in_english.meaning: Ayiq: one who awakens or stirs something, often associated with lice
in_english.long_meaning: The name Ayiq originates from Arabic roots, specifically referring to one who awakens or stirs something, often associated with lice or their habitat. This term can be found in ancient Arabic lexicons. In Islamic tradition, names like Ayiq carry deep meanings related to spiritual awakening or stirring. Historically, such names were given to signify a person's role or character. The name Ayiq symbolizes someone who brings life or movement to something dormant, reflecting a profound spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ibn Abd al-Hakam, Al-Futuh, Cairo, 1935, p. 147. The name Ayiq carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Rasulullah (SAW) appointed Malik ibn Nuwayrah as the governor of Ayla (modern day Aqaba). Ayiq ibn Umayya was the chief of the tribes of Ayla at that time.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ibn Rustah, Kitab Al-masalik wa al-mamalik, Leiden, 1889, p. 117. The name Ayiq carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Ibn Rustah described Ayiq as a village located on the eastern coast of the Red Sea, near the entrance of the Gulf of Aqaba. It was a significant port and trading center during this period.
